description: Fixed upfront price for a ride inside Addis Ababa, Ethiopia — no surge, cash or telebirr/Chapa. Returns distance, ETA and the fare for every vehicle tier (moto, bajaj, economy, comfort, XL). request_ride books at the fare this returns. Also returns book_url: a one-tap bina.et link with this route and fare for the user to confirm.

dropoff.description: Drop-off: a place name in Addis Ababa (e.g. "Edna Mall", "Bole Airport", "Piassa") or "lat,lng" like "9.0108,38.7578".

pickup.description: Pickup: a place name in Addis Ababa (e.g. "Edna Mall", "Bole Airport", "Piassa") or "lat,lng" like "9.0108,38.7578".

name: quote_ride

book_url.description: bina.et/ride link with this route for the user to confirm

estimate.description: true when the route time is an estimate

note.description: How to use or present this result

tier.description: Tier id to pass to request_ride

quotes.description: Fixed fare for each vehicle tier

source_url.description: bina.et page this result comes from; cite it

title: Quote a BinaSmart ride
